req.title: Reject malformed player payload
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity when POST /players/ receives a body that fails Player schema validation.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-009 requires HTTP 422 when POST /players/ receives a body failing PlayerRequestModel schema validation. PlayerRequestModel has three required fields: first_name (str), last_name (str), position (str), and squad_number (int). Tests cover: (1) positive — a fully valid payload returns 201; (2) negative — missing all required fields returns 422; (3) negative — missing individual required fields each return 422; (4) boundary — payload with only optional fields omitted (all required present) returns 201; (5) boundary — squad_number as a non-integer string triggers 422; (6) decision-table — empty body returns 422; (7) negative — extra unknown fields alone (no required fields) returns 422. Assertions use exact status codes (201, 422) to catch comparison-operator mutations. The squad numbers chosen (27+) are outside the pre-loaded 1-26 range to avoid 409 conflicts.

tests.name: test_post_player_valid_payload_returns_201
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Database contains pre-loaded rows with squad numbers 1-26
Squad number 27 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with a fully valid PlayerRequestModel payload (all required fields present, squad_number=27)
expected: Response body contains firstName, lastName, position, squadNumber, and id fields
trace: R-PLAYER-009: valid payload must NOT trigger 422
EP: valid equivalence class — all required fields supplied with correct types
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_valid_payload_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 27,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 27
    assert body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"
    assert "id" in body
